why_byte_identical: This file is a VERBATIM copy of the origin path at the origin commit, deliberately unmodified - no header was added, because adding one would change the bytes and make a drift check against upstream impossible. Provenance lives here instead. Re-vendor with: cp <idea-base.us>/.claude/hooks/heartbeat.sh src/assets/heartbeat.sh && update sha256 + origin_commit above. src/setup.test.js asserts the sha256 recorded here, which catches a local edit; byte-identity with upstream is a cross-repo check neither repo's CI can perform today.
